detail.longDescription: A URL can pass every https:// check and still run code. opencode 1.0.137 to 1.18.32 on Windows/WSL passed a remote MCP server's OAuth URL via npm's open package to PowerShell, which expands $(...) in double quotes. 1.18.33 fixed it with no CVE, so scanners miss old installs. https://www. pillar.security/blog/open-and- shut-remote-code-execution-in-opencode-via-mcp-oauth Watch or answer opencode from a phone: shell opencode, https:// shell.online # Cybersecurity # MCP # AIAgents
